sources.title: Kai'Sa Build Guide: Exploit Their Weaknesses

passive.name: Second Skin
passive.text: Kai'Sa's basic attacks stack Plasma, dealing increasing bonus magic damage. Allies' immobilizing effects help stack Plasma. Additionally, Kai'Sa's item purchases upgrade her basic spells to have more powerful properties.

spells.name: Icathian Rain
spells.text: Kai'Sa shoots a swarm of missiles that seek out nearby targets.Living Weapon: Icathian Rain is upgraded to shoot more missiles.

spells.name: Void Seeker
spells.text: Kai'Sa shoots a long range missile, marking enemies with her passive.Living Weapon: Void Seeker is upgraded to apply more passive marks and reduce cooldown on champion hit.

spells.name: Supercharge
spells.text: Kai'Sa briefly increases her Move Speed, then increases her Attack Speed.Living Weapon: Supercharge is upgraded to briefly grant Invisibility.

spells.name: Killer Instinct
spells.text: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.

damage.value: Kai'Sa is a sustained-damage marksman who can deal heavy burst, and her passive deals magic damage.

archetype.value: Kai'Sa is a ranged bot-lane marksman with a dive-focused kit.

axis.value: Kai'Sa can poke in lane but struggles against heavy poke.

winCondition.value: Kai'Sa can carry through plays, team fights, and securing objectives.

spikes.why: Kai'Sa gains new bonuses and effects that increase her potential.

spikes.at: Item purchases that upgrade Kai'Sa's basic spells
spikes.why: Kai'Sa gains more powerful properties on those spells.

bait.why: After Kai'Sa uses Killer Instinct, she cannot use its dash again until the cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Kai'Sa suffers when positioned poorly because she is squishy and positioning is important.
